$comment: Equipment carried by workers, figures and soldiers. Unlike tools, most equipment does not wear down with production - armour and weapons take damage in combat, potions are consumed on use.

classes.name: Clothing
classes.summary: Protects against weather and event penalties.

classes.name: Potion
classes.summary: One-shot consumable, usually spent during the Labour Roll or a battle.

items.name: Tunic
effects: Ignore the first -1 weather effort penalty each round.

items.name: Winter Coat
effects: Immune to Hard Frost.
No tundra or mountain effort penalty.

items.name: Travelling Cloak
effects: +1 move point for the figure wearing it.

items.name: Sturdy Boots
effects: Marsh and mountain tiles cost 1 less to move through, minimum 1.

items.name: Fine Robes
effects: A merchant wearing these gets a further 10% on every market sale.
Worth 2 victory points at game end.

items.name: Leather Jerkin
effects: Ignore the first hit in each battle.

items.name: Chain Mail
effects: Ignore the first two hits in each battle.

items.name: Plate Harness
effects: Ignore the first three hits in each battle.
-1 move point.

items.name: Helm
effects: Once per battle, cancel one hit.

items.name: Shield
effects: +1 defence die.

items.name: Sword
effects: +1 combat die.

items.name: Steel Sword
effects: +2 combat dice, and hits on 3+ instead of 4+.

items.name: War Axe
effects: +1 combat die, +2 when attacking.

items.name: Pike
effects: +2 combat dice when defending a town.
Cannot be used with a shield.

items.name: Bow
effects: Rolls its dice before the enemy rolls theirs.
+1 output on Hunt Game.
Needs a quiver to fight.

items.name: Quiver of Arrows
effects: Holds 3 uses. Each battle with a bow spends 1.

items.name: Sling
effects: +1 combat die for halflings only. Everyone else may as well throw the stone.

items.name: War Hammer
effects: +2 combat dice. Ignores enemy armour entirely.

items.name: Draught of Vigour
effects: Step one worker's effort die up two sizes for one round.

items.name: Tireless Toil
effects: Re-roll every effort die of one worker and keep the better result.

items.name: Brewmaster's Round
effects: +1 flat effort to every worker in one town this round.

items.name: Healing Draught
effects: Cancel one worker loss, or ignore one Plague card.

items.name: Swiftfoot
effects: Double one figure's move points, or move one cargo token its full speed again this round.

items.name: Stonehide
effects: One unit ignores all hits in one battle.

items.name: Prospector's Clarity
effects: Automatically succeed on one survey, and reveal all deposits on adjacent tiles.

items.name: Merchant's Fortune
effects: Shift one commodity family's price band two steps in your favour for your next sale only.
